g.text: Study the structures of the angiosperm
Identify both female (pistil) and male (stamen) parts.
Match Labels to Blank Target Slots
Check the word bank at the bottom for options.
Use action buttons below to check or request clues.
Pollen is produced in the male Anthers and carried by
pollinators or wind to the sticky receptive surface of the Stigma.
The slender conduit connecting stigma to ovary.
The combined collective term for all three segments.
Petals attract insects, Sepals support petals.

text.tspan: Congratulations! You have successfully identified the reproductive components of a
typical angiosperm flower. This essential biological understanding lays the foundation for
grasping genetic diversity, pollination pathways, and botanic agricultural dynamics.
